sources.title: Enterprise signals: What frontier firms are doing differently
facts: As of June 2026, Codex generated 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers.
Weekly active enterprise Codex users grew 108x in legal, 41x in sales, 41x in recruiting, and 26x in marketing since February.

sources.title: Uniform governance can cause enterprise AI agent failure
facts: Gartner predicts that by 2027, 40% of enterprises will demote or decommission autonomous AI agents because of governance failures.
The research highlights different autonomy levels and trust boundaries as a governance requirement.

sources.title: 2026 Roadmap on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Smart Manufacturing
facts: Industrial AI deployment still faces challenges in industrial big data, data management, and integration with heterogeneous sensing and control systems.
The roadmap identifies robotics, digital twins, logistics optimization, explainable AI, reliability, and safety as important areas.

sources.title: Soitec locks customers into multi-year deals as AI wafer demand surges
facts: Soitec reported rising demand for silicon photonics substrates driven by AI data-center optical interconnects.
The company is using multi-year volume commitments and expanding capacity without planning a new fabrication plant before 2029.

sources.title: Anthropic introduces framework for AI agents to operate physical devices
facts: Anthropic introduced an early Model Hardware Standard for AI agents operating lab and industrial devices.
The framework is designed for programmable physical devices including instruments and robotic arms.

opportunities.title: The enterprise agent control plane gap
opportunities.thesis: As enterprise work shifts from AI assistance to delegated execution, integration, permissions, observability, and governance become a distinct operating problem.
counterSignals: Platform vendors may absorb governance and integration into existing enterprise suites.
Security requirements can slow buying cycles enough to compress the addressable early market.
opportunities.nextTest: Interview five workflow owners and security/IT stakeholders around one delegated workflow. Ask for a paid pilot before building a platform.
unknowns: Which workflow has an existing budget owner?
Can a narrow integration product be purchased without a platform procurement cycle?
How much of the control plane will be bundled by incumbent software vendors?

opportunities.title: The industrial AI integration layer
opportunities.thesis: Industrial AI adoption creates demand for software that connects heterogeneous equipment, data, and AI systems without requiring full factory replacement.
counterSignals: Industrial integration is service-heavy and can be difficult to standardize.
Existing automation integrators may own customer access.
opportunities.nextTest: Choose one measurable production bottleneck and map the existing machine, PLC, data, and operator workflow. Test a concierge integration with one site.
unknowns: Which vertical has the shortest approval path?
Can savings be measured within one deployment cycle?
Who owns the integration budget: plant, IT, or integrator?

opportunities.title: AI optical interconnect supply-chain opportunities
opportunities.thesis: Accelerating AI data-center optical demand can create adjacent opportunities in capacity planning, supplier intelligence, qualification, and inventory coordination.
counterSignals: Large incumbents and long qualification cycles create high barriers to entry.
Demand growth can be captured directly by established component suppliers.
opportunities.nextTest: Map three upstream bottlenecks and identify whether smaller buyers have an information or coordination problem that can be sold independently.
unknowns: Where does information asymmetry remain despite long-term contracts?
Which supplier tier lacks modern intelligence tooling?
